purpose:
Simple NDA between two parties

I’m a freelance designer / content creator and need an agreement with a client that keeps adding work beyond what we first discussed. It began as logo + basic brand kit, then became social media graphics, revisions, web edits, urgent weekend asks, and consulting calls. Payment timing keeps drifting and they assume every tweak is included. I want to keep the client, but I need boundaries. Need something clear on original scope, extra work rates, revision limits, turnaround times, rush requests, ownership after payment, deposits / payment deadlines, and a simple way to approve added work before I start it.
